title: Feature request: Support for Manual Entry of External Insulin Injection via Pen for AndroidAPS on Android and Wear OS
symptom: The user requests a feature to manually log insulin administered via an external pen on Android and Wear OS, to extend patch pump wear time and track insulin during activities without a smartphone.
fix: The feature already exists; the user should enable the checkbox 'record bolus only' in the insulin settings.
evidence_quote: That is already possible. Checkbox, record bolus only.
